name: Wadi Wurayah
description: Wadi Wurayah is a rugged canyon of about 12,700 hectares in the Hajar Mountains of Fujairah, in the eastern United Arab Emirates. Its rare permanent streams and pools sustain lush greenery in an otherwise arid landscape. More than 1,000 species of plants and animals have been recorded here, including about half the country's land mammals and at least ten globally threatened species.
